Manotu\'s own code is open source (MIT). It is built from these open-source components:

Manotu only has your approximate location (about 1–3 km), so your arrow can sit on the wrong road and turns come at the wrong time. Allow precise location to navigate. Your location stays on your phone; while navigating only anonymous speed points are shared.
Approximate location only: directions may be wrong
Components that are not open source
Manotu uses three Google services on Android. None of them receives your favourites, places or trips.
Google Play services location: turns GPS, Wi-Fi and mobile signals into your position on the phone, for the map and navigation.
Google sign-in and Drive authorisation: only when you choose Google Drive backup. Drive receives only the backup YOU send to your own Drive.
Play Integrity: when you confirm a nearby place, checks the vote comes from a real phone. Only a pass/fail verdict reaches Manotu.

Demo mode uses built-in sample places, reports and routes around Kuala Lumpur, and drives along the route by itself (a simulated drive), so you can try everything from anywhere, without an account.\n\nNothing you do is sent to Manotu\'s server: searches, routes, reports, reviews, photos, complaints, feedback and crash reports stay on this phone (feedback is not delivered). Favourites, planned drives and backups work as usual. Map tiles still load from OpenFreeMap.

This deletes your account on Manotu\'s server: your pseudonym, reputation, inbox and any contact details you left on feedback. Your public reports, reviews, photos and places stay for other drivers but are anonymised (no longer linked to you).\n\nThis phone then forgets your contributor key, so your recovery code no longer works. Favourites, recents, \"Just for me\" places and planned drives were never on the server; they stay on this phone unless you tick below.

Reviews, photos, places, reports and votes are public and help other drivers. Before you post:
No abusive, hateful, sexual, violent or otherwise objectionable content, and no personal information about others.
Content that breaks these rules is removed, and users who post it can be suspended.
You can block any user: their reviews and photos are hidden on your phone.
See something wrong? Tap Report on the review, or Report photo. Moderators check reports.
